info.name: Denmark Bike Node Edges (Cykelrute-forbindelser)
info.description:
Fetches the connecting route segments ('edges') of Denmark's numbered cycle-node network from OpenStreetMap via the Overpass API.

In the node-network tagging scheme (same one used across DK/NL/BE), each edge between two numbered nodes is mapped as a relation: type=route, route=bicycle, network=rcn. Each relation's way members are the physical path between its two nodes; its node members are the two endpoint waypoints (see the companion 'Denmark Bike Nodes' collection).

Run 'All Bike Node Edges - Denmark (Overpass main)' first; use the mirror if overpass-api.de is slow/rate-limited.

Note: this is a much heavier query than the nodes-only one — full country returns many thousands of relations plus their way/node members with full geometry. Expect 60-180s server-side, and consider using the single-municipality example while testing.

item.name: All Bike Node Edges - Denmark (Overpass main)

request.description:
Overpass QL query for every node-network route relation (an 'edge') in Denmark. The first 'out body;' prints the relations themselves (with their node/way member refs and roles). '>;' recurses down to pull in every member way and node. The final 'out body geom qt;' prints those members with full line geometry for ways and coordinates for nodes.

Each relation's tags typically include rcn_ref-style from/to references or a name describing the two connected node numbers — check the 'tags' object on each relation element in the response.

item.name: All Bike Node Edges - Denmark (Overpass mirror)

request.description: Same query as the main request, routed to the Kumi Systems Overpass mirror. Use this if overpass-api.de is rate-limiting or timing out.

item.name: Bike Node Edges - Single Municipality (example: Tønder Kommune)

request.description: Narrower example scoped to a single kommune — swap the 'name' value to any Danish municipality. Much faster for testing before running the full-country query.
